visual_language.direction: solid corporate professional deck, institutional credibility, balanced authoritative layout, measured color temperature, confident conservative structure, refined execution-grade report look

content_review.reviewer_note: 结构完整（负面约束+密度映射在案）：候选晋升，需 U3 语义审阅补主题绑定与特征后转 active

legacy_payload.best_for: 需要权威感、信赖感与公司级正式度的商务演示,如商业计划书、公司介绍、经营汇报与对外提案
legacy_payload.visual_direction: solid corporate professional deck, institutional credibility, balanced authoritative layout, measured color temperature, confident conservative structure, refined execution-grade report look

canvas.background: white and light warm gray, subtle grid, generous quiet margins
canvas.composition: title block, sanctioned body modules, steady reading rhythm, restrained emphasis

color_palette.accent: one controlled accent (gold #D4AF37 or corporate teal #0F766E)
color_palette.neutral: near-black #111827, muted gray #64748B, hairline #D1D5DB, light bg #F5F7FA
color_palette.rule: conservative, trustworthy, low-saturation; avoid neon, playful colors, oversized decoration; semantic status pair (success green #059669 / alert red #DC2626) allowed outside the 60-30-10 accent share for status meaning only, never decoration

typography.title: strong confident sans-serif or a restrained serif, authoritative hierarchy
typography.body: clean legible sans-serif, tight grid, left-aligned
typography.labels: small precise labels for sections, figures, dates
typography.text_quality: accurate, formal, brand-consistent; no casual wording

layout_patterns: sagment structure: business overview, product, market, strategy, financials
earnings/result summary with clean charts and a steady narrative
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: Keep a formal, credible corporate voice; let each slide build one argument; use restrained accent for key figures only.

labels: 公司名称 / 一句话定位
行业标签 / 年份 / 关键数字

visual_elements.allowed: clean corporate graphics, subtle gradients, refined charts, currency figures, restrained iconography, one accent band
visual_elements.avoid: cartoonish elements, excessive gradients, clashing colors, crowded data tables, promotional exaggeration

rendering_constraints: Feels like a top-tier corporate annual report, not a template fill-in.
Charts and figures must be legible and polished; avoid Excel screenshot vibes.
One accent for emphasis; do not over-decorate. No invented brand logo or watermark.
legacy_payload.reference: GitHub: gbif/ppt-template · joelparkerhenderson/pitch-deck · 金融奢华趋势
